changes: Revamped landing page and login.
Added Backlog feature to track games you are currently playing or plan to start soon (this feature will be expanded in future updates).
Added time tracking option in profile. If enabled, you can track time in backlog items and new playthroughs.
Added timeline view to see more specifically when you finished games.
Reworked table view and added sorting options for scores, platforms, and finish dates.
Improved styling of playthrough forms and cards to display new data.
Reworked topbar navigation to make it more intuitive.
Added cover-support for clipboard cards.
Your recorded playthroughs now display official game cover art, making them easier to recognize and more enjoyable to browse.
Automatically fetch and suggest high-quality cover images from IGDB for your games—no manual uploads needed!
Older playthroughs will continue to work seamlessly, whether they include covers or not.
Polished the visual style of clipboard cards to improve clarity and aesthetics.
Added more stats to the dashboard, for example distribution of medals and average score per year.
Fixed a lot of minor bugs and added performance improvements.
You can mark records as favorite now to highlight them.
You can filter your overview by favorite records.
Fixed issue where the finish date was not saved correctly
Added filter for dropdown of locations
Improved detail view with new design
Several improvements to layout
Several improvements to table/smartphone layout
Improved design of clipboard card
Added copy to clipboard functionality for game records
Added profile settings to its own page as first part of new user settings
Added more diverse stats: current year average rating, previous year average rating, year with highest average rating, latest highest rated game with improved formatting
Improved backend communication
Improved table view
Added new table-view for game records as alternative for card-view
Added several new locations for retro platforms
Score system adjusted: reachedPoints / (countedCategories * 10) * 100
Added toolbar to detail view for unified design
Several design improvements
Color settings will be saved
Added toolbar to the entry overview
Added search functionality to the entry overview
Moved info popup to the new toolbar
Added patch notes functionality
Released as private beta
